Rashi on Sotah 10a:1:1.hebrew: הוחל שבועתו של אבימלך - בטלה. לשון "לא יחל דברו" (במדבר ל), לפי שהם עברו על השבועה תחילה:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:1:1.english: The oath of Avimelekh was profaned - It was nullified. The expression is from "he shall not profane his word" (Numbers 30); [it was nullified] because they were the first to transgress the oath.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:1.hebrew: במה בירכו - כל ברכה שבמקרא לשון ריבוי הוא, דבר המרבה ומצוי בו שובע, פוייש"ן (פוישו"ן: שפע) בלע"ז. ומה ברכה נמצא בו? לא מצינו עושר בשמשון:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:1.english: With what did He bless him? - Every [instance of] blessing in Scripture is an expression of increase: something that increases and has abundance in it — poyshon (poyshon: abundance) in the vernacular (Old French). And what blessing was found in him? We do not find wealth in Samson.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:2.hebrew: שברכו באמתו - להיות זרעו כנחל שוטף. למה שנתאוה, נתברך:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:2:2.english: That He blessed him with his truth - That his offspring should be like a flowing stream. [He was blessed] with that which he desired.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:3:1.hebrew: נקם אחת משתי עיני - שכר אחת מעיני תן לי בנקמה זו, ושכר האחרת לעולם הבא:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:3:1.english: Avenge [me] one [vengeance] for my two eyes - Give me the reward for one of my eyes through this vengeance, and the reward for the other in the World to Come.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:4:1.hebrew: שחוזר לאחוריו - כשצדין אותו, אינו (מרחיק) לברוח, אלא חוזר עקלקלות:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:4:1.english: That it turns back - When they hunt it, it does not run far away to flee, but rather turns back along winding paths.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:5:1.english: On his shoulders - According to the measure of his shoulders.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:5:2.english: The gate of the city - The verse is speaking of Gaza.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:1.hebrew: קמי דשתי חמרא חמרא - לפני כל אדם מביאין מה שהוא רגיל בו: לפני שותי יין — מביאין יין:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:1.english: Before one who drinks wine, [bring] wine - Before every person, they bring what he is accustomed to; before those who drink wine, they bring wine.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:2.hebrew: קמי רפוקא גרידיא דובלא - לפני עובד אדמה וחופר בגנות, שרגיל לאכול ירק, מביאין סל מלא ירק. דובלי מין ירק הוא:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:6:2.english: Before a digger, a scraper, a basket - Before a tiller of the soil who digs in gardens and is accustomed to eating vegetables, they bring a basket full of vegetables. "Dubli" is a type of vegetable.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:7:1.hebrew: קארי ובוציני - מין אחד הוא, אלא שאלו גדולים ואלו קטנים. כלומר, במה שהוא עוסק — היא עסוקה:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:7:1.english: Kari and butzini - They are one species, except that these are large and those are small. That is to say, in whatever he is engaged, she is engaged.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:1.english: As one - Like the Unique One of the world, in just judgment.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:2.hebrew: שמש - לשון חומה, כמו "ושמתי כדכוד שמשותיך" (ישעיהו נ״ד:י״ב):
Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:2.english: Shemesh - An expression for a wall, as in "And I will make your battlements [shimshotayich] of rubies" (Isaiah 54:12).

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:3.hebrew: על שמו של הקב"ה - משמע שכינהו בשמו של הקב"ה ממש:
Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:3.english: By the name of the Holy One, Blessed be He - This implies that he called him [Samson] by the actual name of the Holy One, Blessed be He.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:8:4.english: Corresponding to his name - For "shemesh" [sun] here does not mean literally the sun, but rather a shield and protector.

Rashi on Sotah 10a:9:1.hebrew: שפי - אשלויישי"ש, כמו "דשף מדוכתיה" (חולין דף מב:):
Rashi on Sotah 10a:9:1.english: Shefi - [Old French] *eslaïssié* ("dislocated"), like "he was dislocated [*dashaf*] from his place" (Chullin 42b).

Tosafot on Sotah 10a:8:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה לא ימחה - תימה לרבי: מאי שנא משלום? דאמר בפ"ק דשבת (דף י:): אמר רב המנונא משמיה דעולא: אסור לאדם שיתן שלום לחבירו בבית המרחץ, משום דשם גופיה איקרי שלום, כדכתיב: "ויקרא לו ה' שלום". ולא קא חשיב ליה במס' סופרים (פ"ד) בהדי שמות שאין נמחקין! ונראה דתנא ושייר. ועדיף מחנון ורחום, דאמר בפרק שבועת העדות (שבועות דף לה.) דנמחק, דלא אשכחן שקרא הקב"ה שמו כך חנון. והכא פריך אהא דקאמר "על שמו של הקב"ה נקרא", משמע דשמו נקרא כך, והיינו דקא דחי: אלא מעין שמו, כמו חנון, על שם שהוא חונן ומרחם על בריותיו:
Tosafot on Sotah 10a:8:1.english: But if so, it should not be erased - It is astonishing to the Rabbi: How is this different from "Shalom"? For it says in the first chapter of Shabbat (10b): Rav Hamnuna said in the name of Ulla: It is forbidden for a person to greet his fellow with "Shalom" in a bathhouse, because [God's] name itself is called "Shalom," as it is written: "And he called Him 'Hashem-Shalom'" (Judges 6:24). Yet [the Tanna] does not count it in Tractate Soferim (chapter 4) among the names that are not erased! And it appears that the Tanna taught [some] and omitted [others]. And [Shalom] is stronger than "Chanun" and "Rachum," which it says in the chapter Shevuat HaEdut (Shevuot 35a) may be erased, since we do not find that the Holy One, blessed be He, called His name "Chanun" in this way. And here [the Gemara] objects to what it said, "it is called by the name of the Holy One, blessed be He," which implies that His name is called thus; and that is why it rejects [this]: Rather, [it is] "in the likeness of His name," like "Chanun," because He is gracious and merciful to His creatures.
